newsitem.title: USA: Cell Genesys licenses gene technology.
newsitem.headline: Cell Genesys licenses gene technology.

text.p: Cell Genesys Inc said on Thursday it has agreed to license gene activation technology to Hoechst Marion Roussel in a deal that could generate up to $26 million in milestone payments and fees, in addition to royalties on future sales.
The companies signed a letter of intent for which Cell Genesys received $4.0 million. The two expect to sign a definitive agreement in the first quarter of 1997.
The agreement covers Cell Genesys's technology for erythropoietin (EPO) and a second, undisclosed protein.

The licensing pact is the second agreement between Hoechst Marion Roussel and Cell Genesys. In October 1995, the companies formed a corporate partnership to fund Cell Genesys'ss AIDS gene therapy program. Since then, the company has received over $45 million in funding including a 13 percent equity investment by Hoechst Marion Roussel.
